items.title: Were the confirmed protected-area Burmese errors corrected without standardizing other forms?
assumptions: Only the 17 high-confidence protected-area records and 26 fields from the preceding audit were in scope.
Existing non-standard ဥ်/ဉ် forms, the known တိရိစ္ဆာန် issue, and review-only wording or name differences were not remediated.
The malformed ဥယျာက် was corrected to the record's existing style ဥယျာဥ်, rather than standardizing it to ဥယျာဉ်.

source.label: Wildlife protected-area data
filters: Excluded issue: တိရိစ္ဆာန်
caveats: The current source contains 54 occurrences of ဥ်. One occurrence was introduced when the malformed ဥယျာက် was corrected to the same ဥယျာဥ် style used by that record; the 53 pre-existing occurrences were not standardized.
Review-only findings, including the duplicate ဆတ် label and နှစ်စဉ်နှစ်တိုင်း wording, remain unchanged.

evidenceFlow.title: Targeted error validation
evidenceFlow.detail: None of the 17 reviewed incorrect spellings or repetition patterns remained in the corrected source fields.

evidenceFlow.title: Database parity and integrity
evidenceFlow.detail: All 26 corrected database fields matched the JSON source, all 39 protected-area records remained present, and SQLite integrity_check returned ok.

evidenceFlow.title: Excluded-text preservation
evidenceFlow.detail: The known တိရိစ္ဆာန် text remained in all 6 source and database occurrences, and review-only findings remained present.
